name: Dark Scarf
description: A dark-colored scarf with a silver bird brooch pinned to it. First appears worn by an elderly visitor in the museum theatre, later found lying across a front-row seat.
narrative_significance: The dark scarf with silver bird brooch serves as a mysterious marker of presence and connection to Mara's past. Its appearance in the afternoon scene worn by an elderly visitor who knew Mara, and its reappearance abandoned on the front-row seat in the evening scene, suggests a supernatural or ambiguous presence. The scarf's presence correlates with the mysterious voice reciting Mara's recorded line, creating an atmosphere of haunting and unresolved connection to the deceased Mara.
